title: Integer-coefficient conjecture for Wronskian Hermite polynomials
statement:
Let $\lambda$ be a partition, and let $\operatorname{He}_{\lambda}(x)$ denote the monic Wronskian Hermite polynomial associated with $\lambda$. **Integer-coefficient conjecture.** For every partition $\lambda$ we have

$$
\operatorname{He}_{\lambda}(x)\in\mathbb{Z}[x].
$$

The analogous assertion holds for the ordinary monic Hermite polynomials, while the paper notes that rationality of the coefficients is known for Wronskian Hermite polynomials. The conjecture strengthens this rationality statement to integrality.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1801.07980

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of January 2018).
source_name: Niels Bonneux and Marco Stevens, “Recurrence Relations for Wronskian Hermite Polynomials”, arXiv:1801.07980 (2018).
